page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5 family. It is equipped with 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and 240.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB of RAM per core. The instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to manage its virtualized resources.

For acceleration, the server features four integrated NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. Local storage is bundled with the instance, consisting of a 1889 GB SSD. Additionally, the network interface supports a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Given the inclusion of multiple dedicated GPUs, high memory capacity, and local SSD storage, this instance is designed for resource-dense parallel processing workloads. It is suitable for deep learning training, scientific simulations, high-performance computing, and GPU-accelerated database operations.
